name: Ezekiel
source: Ezekiel would be cute…if he’d just keep his mouth shut. He’s sullen, irritable, and clearly hates you from the get-go. Even though he’d follow Zev to the grave, he still drives Nolan insane with his abrasive attitude and casual approach to his duties.
